content: Sneha Roy inquired about the final premium and payment options for her 2022 Honda Civic insurance quote. Anjali Desai provided the annual premium of ₹12,450, explained a 5% discount for upfront annual payment (reducing it to ₹11,828) along with a 10% no-claim bonus, and shared payment methods (netbanking, UPI, card, cheque) with a secure payment link.

action_items: Customer to complete the payment via the provided secure link
